question: Is direct ordinary-attention rereading of the original or repeated question wording required for later Second Chance computation?

scope.first_stem_blockade: Every query from the feedback token onward is prevented from reading 1P question-stem/separator K/V at every ordinary-attention layer.
scope.second_stem_blockade: Every 2P option-line, post-list cue/query, and final-prefix query is prevented from reading causally prior 2P question-stem/separator K/V at every ordinary-attention layer.
scope.untouched: First-pass computation, both sets of option lines, all GLA recurrence, and question information already embedded in other token states.
